kp_title: KP 1. Finding Part of an Image
raw_html:
1.?

Consider the square region Δ in the uv-plane, given by Δ={(u,v):0≤u≤1,0≤v≤1},

and the transformation T, given by T:(u,v)→(x(u,v),y(u,v)), where

x=v2−u,y=uv.

The image of the side S3 under the action of T is given by x=x(t),y=t,1≥t≥0.
